_source: EVIMO2 v2 ground-truth quality review of all 173 sequences (2026-10-10): the sequences, cameras and windows whose pose or event ground truth is unusable.
semantics: seqs: fnmatch patterns over <category>/<split>/<sequence>; cameras: limits an entry to those camera folders (default all). bad: refuse to score or calibrate (the bench errors unless --allow-bad, and never scores it). suspect: exclude_cameras are refused like bad. object: drop the named bodies (EVIMO catalogue names) from comparison regions and edge-timing GT; with "render": "drop" the bench also leaves them out of the render (scene.evimo2.objects), for a body whose fitted track is a hold far from the GT (its orientation branch is rejected where the span lies, so the render would show a phantom). timing: no clock or edge-timing use (the bench marks the span untimed and M11 report-only). flags: GT correct but an assumption broken (reported). clean_spans_s: [[t0, t1], ...] on the true clock where the restriction was checked not to apply; windows_s: the entry applies only to spans overlapping one of these windows (and to whole-sequence use). suspect entries without exclude_cameras are reported as flags.
